title: Spell Boy
description:
Spell Boy is 2d Pixel Art Wizard/Mage Game where coordination, timing and strategy comes into play

Mutiple Spells to Master12 Spells to master, each comes with its own uniqueness and strength. You have to use the right spell for the right situation.Challenging Dungeons16 Dungeons to beat where each dungeon is designed to be as engaging and fun as possible.Pixel ArtEverything is hand drawn pixel art and as unique and beautiful it can be.
description_short: Wizard/Mage RPG - combat centric - dungeon crawler where you have to master your spells to conquer the dungeons. It comes with handpicked spells and enemies to make enjoyable gameplay. Master the spells and conquer the dungeons!! Its a game of timing, coordination and strategy!!
